reference.crownIdentityQualification: The physically viewed upright figure has its unique uppermost contour on its head/hat, not an effect or neighbouring actor. This is a drawing-contour point, not an inferred skull landmark.
reference.soleIdentityQualification: The lowest retained body contour was physically viewed as a shoe sole; explicit cane-x exclusion, where supplied, prevents a cane tip from replacing the shoe. Projected posture remains a limitation.

landmarkPairs.name: projected-head-crown-to-chin
landmarkPairs.measurementScope: Actual visible source-native contour/chin/shoe points. Two projected visual segments; crown-to-sole depends on stance and head-to-chin on head/hat tilt. Manual chin uncertainty is approximately4nativepixels, so the proposal is not anatomical certification.

landmarkPairs.name: projected-crown-to-visible-shoe-sole
landmarkPairs.measurementScope: Actual visible source-native contour/chin/shoe points. Two projected visual segments; crown-to-sole depends on stance and head-to-chin on head/hat tilt. Manual chin uncertainty is approximately4nativepixels, so the proposal is not anatomical certification.

entries.choiceMethod: Arithmetic midpoint of the two explicitly observed projected-segment estimates, rounded to native pixels; a transparent visual compromise proposal, not a true anatomical stature. Root may reject/refine the choice.

limits: Manual coordinate proposals are read from actual unmodified source magnifications and remain counterreviewable.
The midpoint recipe is a display choice, not an assertion that both projected lengths measure anatomical stature.
Original PNGs, old jobs and old held calibrations remain preserved.
